questions.explanation: Trade was indeed considered important by mercantilists, but with a focus as achieving a favorable balance of trade. They believed that a nation should export more than it imports to accumulate wealth in the form of precious metals. This emphasis on trade as a means to boost a nation's economic strength was a key aspect of Mercantilist philosophy.
